Saunas

Saunas

Discover a sanctuary of rejuvenation at King Spa, where ancient Korean healing traditions come alive in our 10 unique saunas and therapy rooms. Each space is designed to promote holistic well-being, offering a serene retreat that harmonizes body, mind, and spirit. Enter these sacred spaces and leave your worries at the door.

  • Charcoal Sauna
  • Amethyst Sauna
  • Pink Salt Sauna
  • Yellow Mud Sauna
  • Bul Ga Ma Sauna
  • Ice Room
  • Bul Han Jing Mak Sauna
  • Base Rock Sauna
  • 24k Gold Sauna
  • Hinoki + Ion Therapy Room
Baths & Pools

Baths and Pools

Hydrotherapy is an important part of the Korean bathhouse and spa culture. At King Spa, there are so many ways you can indulge in hydrotherapy techniques, known to melt stress away, enhance relaxation, and relieve aches and pains. In our gender-segregated bathhouses, you’ll discover hot tubs at various temperatures, steam rooms, and our cold plunge pool. On our rooftop, you can enjoy our 30,000 gallon heated outdoor bade pool with 50 waterjets, open all-year round. Or take a relaxing dip in our indoor Aqua pool with waterfall.
Locker Rooms

Locker Rooms

Experience unmatched cleanliness and comfort in King Spa’s locker rooms, where your journey of relaxation begins. These gender-segregated spaces are meticulously maintained, ensuring a hygienic and tranquil environment. Upon arrival, each guest receives a complimentary uniform, signifying the start of a rejuvenating spa experience. With an abundance of showers and free toiletries at your disposal, you’re invited to refresh and unwind at your own pace.
Dinning & Refreshments

Dinning and Refreshments

Savor the wellness-inspired dining experience at King Spa, where our menu blends nutritious, flavorful options with the art of healthy living. Enjoy a selection of traditional Korean specialties and contemporary American dishes, all crafted from the freshest ingredients to support your spa journey. Complement your meal with herbal teas, fresh juices, and infused waters, each designed to rejuvenate and hydrate.

Facial Treatments

With so many facial spa treatment options to choose from at King Spa, such as our Basic Facial, Discovery Facial, and 24K Gold Facial, you can be sure we have one specifically suited to your skin type, needs, and desires. Our professional facials can address a multitude of skin concerns such as tired and stressed out skin, aging skin, impurities, dull skin, wrinkles, blemishes, dry or oily skin, and much more.

Massage
Treatments
Cost of treatment will be Additional

Massage Treatments

Discover relaxation and renewal with King Spa’s variety of massage therapies, where ancient Korean techniques meet your unique needs for a balanced body and mind. Our massages—from soothing Swedish to deep tissue inspired by Korean traditions—ease stress and muscle soreness, enhancing well-being. In our tranquil spa setting, our expert therapists’ healing touch will guide you to bliss and vitality.
Korean Body
Scrubs
Cost of treatment will be Additional

Korean Body Scrubs

Experience the revitalizing power of Korean Body Scrubs at King Spa, where tradition meets modern wellness. Our scrub treatments, rooted in centuries-old Korean practices, deeply exfoliate and rejuvenate your skin, leaving it silky smooth and radiantly healthy. Performed by expert therapists, these scrubs not only cleanse but also improve circulation and promote cell renewal. And don’t forget to try our Couple’s Bubble Body Scrub!
V-Steam
Cost of treatment will be Additional

V-Steam

Discover the rejuvenating benefits of the V-Steam at King Spa, a gentle and holistic treatment inspired by traditional Korean wellness practices. This ancient therapy is designed to promote balance and well-being, using herbal steam to soothe, cleanse, and revitalize. Tailored to enhance female reproductive health, the V-Steam supports circulation, helps to reduce stress, and encourages a state of deep relaxation. Performed in a serene and private setting, it’s an experience that nurtures both body and spirit, inviting a sense of harmony and renewal.

children.html:
What do I need to bring for my spa day at King Spa Virginia?
  • Valid government issued photo ID (pictures of ID’s and foreign driver’s licenses will not be accepted)
  • Swimsuit (Cotton & denim swimwear are not allowed in the water)
  • (Swimsuits are available for purchase in the Locker Rooms.)
  • Spa lounge uniforms & towels are provided during your stay at King Spa Virginia.

children.html:
Are children allowed at King Spa Virginia?

Children under the age of 12 are not permitted under any circumstances. Minors under 17 years old must be accompanied by an adult 21+ years old and of the same gender. A maximum of 3 children per adult of the same gender are permitted.

(Minors will need a school ID or copy of birth certificate)

What are the outdoor pool hours?

Outdoor pool hours are the following:

  • Sunday – Thursday 10 AM – 10 PM
  • Friday – Saturday 10 AM –  11 PM

Do I need a reservation to visit King Spa Virginia?

No, we are on a first come first serve basis at the moment.

What does my day pass include?

Your daily admission pass includes access to: 

  • Locker Room & Steam Rooms
  • Saunas & Base Rock Room
  • Outdoor & Indoor Bade Pools
  • Jacuzzis & Cold Plunge Pool
  • Media Room & Indoor Lounges

Your pass also includes:

  • Spa uniforms (all sizes available. Must be worn during your visit)
  • Complimentary toiletries
  • Towels
  • Shampoo/conditioner/soap

Please Note:

  • Remember to bring your bathing suit if you plan to visit our outdoor or indoor bade pools (you cannot enter these pools without appropriate swimwear).
  • Spa treatments, products, food & beverages are available for an additional fee
  • You cannot leave our facility once you have entered. Please remember to bring all your belongings with you BEFORE entering the spa.
